LightningComponentBundle.description: A dynamic related list component that fetches and displays data from AWS S3 for any object. Mimics the standard Salesforce related list experience.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title displayed in the component header.

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name
property.description: SLDS icon name (e.g., standard:contact, standard:account). Leave empty to use the icon from S3 data.

property.name: bucketName
property.label: S3 Bucket Name
property.description: The name of the AWS S3 bucket.

property.name: objectKey
property.label: S3 Object Key (File Path)
property.description: The file path / key of the JSON file in S3 (e.g., data/contacts.json).

property.name: region
property.label: AWS Region
property.description: The AWS region where the S3 bucket is located.

property.name: authMode
property.label: Auth Mode
property.description: How to authenticate with AWS S3.

property.name: presignedUrl
property.label: Pre-Signed URL
property.description: (presigned_url mode) The full pre-signed URL for the S3 object.

property.name: accessKey
property.label: AWS Access Key
property.description: (direct mode) AWS Access Key ID.

property.name: secretKey
property.label: AWS Secret Key
property.description: (direct mode) AWS Secret Access Key.

property.name: fieldsList
property.label: Fields to Display
property.description: Comma-separated field API names to display (e.g., Name,Email,Phone). Leave empty to show all fields from S3 data.

property.name: sortByField
property.label: Sort By Field
property.description: Field API name to sort by initially.

property.name: sortDirection
property.label: Sort Direction
property.description: Initial sort direction.

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to load from S3 (0 = unlimited).

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field API name to filter records on.

property.name: filterValue
property.label: Filter Value
property.description: Value to match when filtering records.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Page Size
property.description: Number of records per page.

property.name: showSearchBar
property.label: Show Search Bar
property.description: Show a client-side search bar.

property.name: showRefreshButton
property.label: Show Refresh Button
property.description: Show a refresh button in the header.

property.name: showViewAll
property.label: Show View All Button
property.description: Show a View All button in the header.

property.name: showRowNumbers
property.label: Show Row Numbers
property.description: Display row numbers in the table.

property.name: hideCheckbox
property.label: Hide Checkboxes
property.description: Hide row selection checkboxes.

property.name: emptyStateMessage
property.label: Empty State Message
property.description: Message shown when no records are available.
